context: The product calls its objects Projects. Archive is reversible; Delete is permanent. Save failures supply an error code only; no cause is known. Notification permission is optional. The English and Spanish strings below are approved except where an inconsistency is demonstrable.

ios.notification_reality: Projects remain usable when notifications are denied.
